author: Javipepe
body:
To put it in only one sentence, we are looking into ways of displaying +1 rank in a player's name, meaning if you are a dev and a mod, you kinda get "recognition" for both, same for mods and donators, etc; while looking good and not to crowded (not MODERATOR AND REFEREE AND DEVELOPER AND GOLD | javipepe > o)

I have been brainstorming lots of ideas, but they look awkwardly odd. We have very creative users here and hopefully we can get something cool from you :)

Also if your idea gets done you'll have a very big cookie and a very great thank you from the developer team :)

replies.body:
We could do it by using the Greek letter Omega. Hence, the Omega update. Ω

Each end of the Omega's little "hooks" at the bottom represent the player's most important role to them. For instance, if a player preferred being a MapDev the little "Hooks" at the bottom would display the color of the MapDev rank. 

The "Arch" of the Greek letter (Ω) would display the rest of the colors. (No donator ranks)

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Look, the whole thing is that it's pretty unclear at the moment, and we want to make it look better and be more understandable to the general player base. I'm going to take myself as an example.

I'm a developer, a moderator, and an advisor. Developer blatantly overrides moderator, and advisor doesn't show up on publics. I get called everyday for "can devs kick?!!!one!?", "are you a mapdev", "y'r a mod too wtf???".  It is unclear and they would have to go check my profile to see what's going on with me. 

Taken from every current package at avicus.net/shop, every donor receives a -rank- badge. People that get promoted lose perks they paid for, which is really unfair.

The point is to arrange the prefix system so it's:
  • More clear
  • Noob friendly
  • Understandable
  • Not cluttered

replies.author: ALM
replies.body: Hmm, choosing the character would be a tough decision and should be considered with originality in mind. If we were to use symbols, I feel that the surrounding brackets would become cluttering. I believe that the ranks should be either not surrounded by brackets, or that they should all be in one set of brackets. I also think the tooltips should be formatted so that they can be read quickly and easily. Different symbols for each rank could become confusing, I like the other proposed idea of having the tooltip contain all of the ranks.
